canonical.full_scope: One lossless, versioned import/direct-PUT/merge contract for merchandising, lifecycle/windows, stage aliases, registry tags and locale/slot vocabulary. Canonical content type drives accumulated signals and ranking, including existing film/video mismatch. Decide product-attribute inheritance, warn/reject unusable taxonomy and prove idempotent round trips.
canonical.sizing_owner: S field repair → M/L full schema/feed contract; OL/D + C

criteria.description: Lossless currently supported merchandising/metadata and safe import/direct-write/merge contract.
Customer stage aliases, duplicate tag scoring protection and retained historical receipt compatibility.
Canonical content type across signal/ranking including film/video; registry tags/locale/slot vocabulary and unusable taxonomy policy.
Customer-approved product-attribute inheritance separate from attribution linkage; complete versioned feed and customer round-trip acceptance.
